description: 【京都府八幡市】コミュニティバスやわた時刻表 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 八幡市. 「コミュニティバスやわた」の停車駅と時刻表の一覧です。. Coverage: 八幡市. The portal files it under the publisher 八幡市. Its tags are 一覧, 地域コミュニティ, 推奨データセット, 時刻表, 観光. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2021-10-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
